greeting: The morning in St. Pete is yours before a 4:20 flight to Toronto and the start of ICGN conference week. Good quiet hours to get your Plenary 7 framing down before travel takes over the afternoon.

needsAttention.title: Shape your Plenary 7 opening
needsAttention.detail: You moderate Plenary 7 — Evolving Stewardship Data, Reporting and Impact — Thursday at 3:05 PM, with Rachit Gupta (Diligent), Jane Ambachtsheer (BNP Paribas) and Andy Howard (Schroders). The open morning is the time to draft your framing and a question for each.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: Your top-priority task from Sept 14 is still open: a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week. Portland holiday inventory only thins, so it is worth clearing before the trip firms up.

schedule.title: Flight to Toronto
schedule.detail: Porter PD526, Tampa (TPA) to Toronto, lands 7:17 PM ET

flagged.title: ICGN speaker logistics confirmed
flagged.detail: The events team sent final details: arrive 30 minutes before your 3:05 PM Thursday slot, with a panel photo at the step-and-repeat after.

flagged.title: Two statements posted

Out of Tampa at 4:20 on Porter PD526, landing in Toronto at 7:17.
Into the Richmond Street loft; the ICGN board dinner at Lee is tomorrow night.
